tasks.title: User Authentication & Onboarding System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive user authentication system with email verification, social login, disposable email detection, and device fingerprinting
tasks.details:
Priority: P0 (MVP Critical)

Functional Requirements:
- Email/password registration with real-time validation
- Social login integration (Google, Apple, Facebook)
- Disposable email detection and blocking
- CAPTCHA verification (reCAPTCHA Enterprise)
- Email verification before any feature access
- Device fingerprinting implementation

Technical Specifications:
- Real-time disposable email API integration (NeverBounce/Kickbox)
- Weekly blocklist updates for known disposable providers
- Device fingerprinting capturing browser, OS, GPU, fonts, timezone, screen resolution
- Database schema linking credits to user_id and device_hash
- Redis caching for real-time credit checking

Acceptance Criteria:
- User cannot access any features without verified account
- Disposable emails blocked with user-friendly error message
- Device fingerprint successfully captured and stored
- Social login creates verified account automatically
- CAPTCHA prevents automated signup attempts

🔄 PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED: Basic authentication with email/password, disposable email detection, and device fingerprinting are implemented as mock functionality. Social login and CAPTCHA verification still need to be implemented.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for validation logic, integration tests for social login, E2E tests for signup flow

subtasks.title: Email/Password Registration System
subtasks.description: Implement secure email/password registration with real-time validation
subtasks.details:
✅ COMPLETED: Enhanced Email/Password Registration System

**Implemented Features:**
- Real-time email validation with disposable email detection
- Enhanced password strength validation with visual indicators
- Real-time form validation with immediate feedback
- Improved device fingerprinting with additional browser data
- Enhanced anti-abuse measures with device tracking
- Visual feedback for all form fields (green/red borders, icons)
- Password strength meter with progress bar
- Comprehensive error handling and user feedback

**Technical Improvements:**
- Added 25+ disposable email domains to blocklist
- Implemented password strength scoring (weak/medium/strong)
- Enhanced device fingerprinting with 12+ browser attributes
- Added spam pattern detection for test emails
- Real-time validation with 500ms debouncing
- Form submission disabled until all validations pass

**Testing Results:**
- Email validation works for valid emails and blocks disposable domains
- Password strength correctly identifies weak/medium/strong passwords
- Device fingerprinting generates unique 64-character hashes
- Form validation prevents submission with invalid data
- UI provides clear visual feedback for all validation states

- HD video generation: <30 seconds

tasks.title: Rate Limiting & Resource Protection
tasks.description: Implement API rate limiting, resource usage monitoring, and cost protection measures
tasks.details:
Priority: P0 (MVP Critical)

Rate Limiting by Tier:
- Free: 10 requests/minute, 100 requests/day
- Pro: 100 requests/minute, 5000 requests/day
- Team: 500 requests/minute, 25000 requests/day

Implementation:
- Redis-based sliding window rate limiting
- Per-endpoint specific limits
- IP-based and user-based limiting
- Graceful degradation and queue management

Resource Monitoring:
- CPU usage for video generation
- Storage consumption per user
- Bandwidth utilization
- Third-party API usage costs

Acceptance Criteria:
- Rate limits enforced consistently
- Resource usage stays within budget projections
- Emergency stops prevent cost overruns
- User experience remains smooth within limits
tasks.testStrategy: Load tests for rate limiting, monitoring tests for resource usage

tasks.title: Backend API Architecture
tasks.description: Set up Node.js FastAPI backend with authentication, validation, and database integration
tasks.details:
Priority: P0 (MVP Critical)

API Layer:
- Node.js: Fastify framework for REST APIs
- Python: FastAPI for ML/AI processing
- Authentication: JWT with refresh token rotation
- Validation: Joi/Zod for request validation
- Documentation: OpenAPI/Swagger auto-generation

Database Design:
- Primary DB: PostgreSQL 15 with read replicas
- Caching: Redis Cluster for session and rate limiting
- Search: Elasticsearch for content indexing
- File Storage: AWS S3 with CloudFront CDN

Acceptance Criteria:
- API endpoints follow RESTful conventions
- Authentication system is secure and scalable
- Database schema is optimized for performance
- API documentation is auto-generated and accurate
tasks.testStrategy: API tests, security tests, database performance tests
